name: 记忆石
habitat: 浮落幽谷秘境获得精灵蛋
habitatEn: Obtain egg from Fuluo Valley Secret Realm
description: 埋在土地里露出上半截，就像是石碑一样。通过扫描分析它所散发的波动，能窥见一点点王国百年前的历史。
descriptionEn: Buried in the soil with its upper half exposed, like a stone stele. By scanning and analyzing the waves it emits, one can glimpse a little of the kingdom's history from a century ago.
